bias.en: Bearish · pinned to the Oct 16 low
bias.zh: 偏空 · 贴近 10月16日低点

read.en: Coherent slipped 0.4% on Oct 19 to $232.02, fading from $244.20 to close near the day's low of $231.79; it is below its falling 5-day ($253.8), 10-day ($284.5) and 30-day ($295.4) averages, the rising 200-day ($294.8) and the falling 100-day ($319.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero with the histogram widening, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($316.2), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: Coherent 10月19日下跌 0.4%，收于 $232.02，自 $244.20 回落，收盘接近当日低点 $231.79。股价位于下行的 5 日（$253.8）、10 日（$284.5）和 30 日均线（$295.4）、上行的 200 日均线（$294.8）以及下行的 100 日均线（$319.9）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$316.2），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The Oct 16 low ($231.6) held again, but a rebound to $244 faded and the close stayed below the $235.5 Oct 15 low. Resistance is $235.5, then $244 (Oct 19 high) and $254–255 (5-day average, Sep 3 low $255.3). Support is $231.6, then $221 (Jul 29 low) and the $200 round number. A close below $221 would open $200; a close above $244 would target $255.
read.zh: 10月16日低点（$231.6）再次守住，但反弹至 $244 后回落，收于 $235.5 的 10月15日低点下方。阻力为 $235.5，其次 $244（10月19日高点）和 $254–255（5 日均线，9月3日低点 $255.3）。支撑为 $231.6，其次 $221（7月29日低点）和 $200 整数关口。若收盘跌破 $221，下一目标看 $200；若收盘站上 $244，则看向 $255。
